synchronisation: Simultaneous hypothetical possession and common shock dates. Existing completed/possession illustration only, not current availability. New launch Brightwood remains separate.
excluded: No synthetic personal cash/reserve, no probability/independence assumption, no injected construction delay for completed properties, no new stresses.
pre_calculation_record: Original five-path design fixed in memory before calculation. A separate S3 acquisition-valuation branch was added during applicability audit, before its calculation. Not externally preregistered; no result-based scenario deletion.
valuation_branch: S3 only: bank value 90% of agreed resale price, financing 90% of that value => 81% of price. Rate/term stay 4%/35 years. This is labelled actual-financing sensitivity, never a replacement of the 90% standard and never stacked into J3.
